title: Beestar High School
text:
Beestar High School (hs.beestar.org) offers curriculum-based online programs for high school students, focusing on SAT preparation and other academic subjects[3]. Here are the key features and offerings:
Programs

- **SAT Preparation**: 

 - SAT Math
 - SAT Reading/Writing 
 - SAT Vocabulary
 - Advanced SAT Math
 - Sample Practice All Subjects


- **Other Exercises**: Additional academic programs are available: Computer Science.

Key Points

- **Free SAT Math Program**: Every semester, students can access a free weekly SAT Math program for as long as they want, without any obligation[2][3].

- **Fee-Based Programs**: For 40 per semester, students can access additional programs like SAT Reading/Writing, SAT Vocabulary, or Advanced SAT Math[3].

- **Program Structure**: 

 - Each program typically includes 2 exercises per week
 - Exercises are published on Sunday and due by midnight the following Saturday (CST)
 - Each exercise takes about 10 minutes to complete[3]

- **Account Setup**: A parent is required to set up both parent and student accounts[2].

- **Semester-Based**: Programs are offered on a semester basis, with registration open for specific periods (e.g., Fall 2024)[1].

Usage Tips

1. **Preparation**: Students should preview exercise topics and prepare accordingly.
2. **Timed Exercises**: All exercises are timed to help improve speed and skill mastery.
3. **Regular Practice**: Consistent weekly practice is encouraged for best results[3].

Beestar High School aims to provide comprehensive SAT preparation and academic enrichment for high school students through its online platform, offering both free and paid options to suit different needs and subjects.
